explanation: Each tile pairs two ends from blank to six, and every pairing appears once: 21 tiles with two different ends plus 7 doubles. A double-nine set has 55.

claims.text: A standard double-six domino set has 28 tiles.
A double-six domino set does not have 24, 32 or 36 tiles.
In a double-six set every pairing of the values 0 to 6 appears exactly once, giving 21 tiles with two different ends and 7 doubles.
A double-nine domino set has 55 tiles.
